note: A real finding of the same shape as 04, with the guard removed. Present so the safe examples do not teach that a fetch is never reportable — the difference between this and 04 is one check, and that check is the whole finding.

findings.functional_intent: Deliver a ping event to a caller-supplied webhook endpoint.
findings.violated_safety_invariant: Nothing constrains the endpoint to a public address, so the request can be aimed at internal services the server can reach and the caller cannot.
findings.title: Unconstrained webhook destination
findings.rationale: The endpoint is taken from the request body and fetched with no address check, so a value such as http://169.254.169.254/ reaches link-local infrastructure.
